data.long_meaning: Gulap is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'gul', which means 'calm' or 'serene'. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with Lord Krishna and Radha, representing the deep devotion and love between them. The name evokes a sense of peace and tranquility. The name Gulap carries the meaning “Calm, serene” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gulap usually hope their child will grow to embody calm, serene and live with faith, good character and purpose.
